quests.name: Seeping Corruption
quests.summary: I never dreamed the elixir would take hold that quickly. Thank you, <name>. I will get to work on the rest of these samples right away. I'm sure they'll be usable by the Lady Sylvanas and the Forsaken soon enough.

quests.name: Testing for Corruption - Felwood
quests.summary: You take a sample of slime from Felwood and place some of it into the various tubes and beakers on the table. As things begin to boil and spurt, the slime changes colors. When the process slows down and the liquids calm, you see a small petri dish with your altered Felwood slime samples in it along with some other remnants.

quests.name: Testing for Impurities - Un'Goro Crater
quests.summary: You take a sample of slime from Un'Goro Crater and place some of it into the various tubes and beakers on the table. As things begin to boil and spurt, the slime changes colors. When the process slows down and the liquids calm, you see a small petri dish with your purified Un'Goro slime samples in it along with some other remnants.

quests.name: ... and a Batch of Ooze
quests.summary: Gather Un'Goro Slime Samples from any of the slimes in Un'Goro Crater. Then, using the Testing Equipment next to Chemist Fuely in Undercity, see which of your samples are the most pure. Bring 5 of the Pure Un'Goro Samples you find to Chemist Fuely.

quests.name: Mor'zul Bloodbringer
quests.summary: Speak with Mor'zul Bloodbringer in the Burning Steppes.

quests.name: A Donation of Mageweave
quests.summary: Mageweave is running low, and we could use your help to replenish our stocks!  By counting on the community as a whole, we would only need a donation of 60 pieces of mageweave cloth from you to enable us to reach our goal.  Such generosity would not go unnoticed by the Undercity, I assure you!If you have the sixty pieces of mageweave cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.

quests.name: A Donation of Runecloth
quests.summary: <name>, you've been a tremendous contributor to our cloth drive.  As we work hard to replenish our reserves, one form of cloth remains critically low - runecloth.  We are in absolutely dire need of it, and we hope that you will be able to help us as you have in the past!If you are willing, please bring me what runecloth you can spare.  We'll initially accept a single donation of sixty, and then we'll go from there.

quests.name: A Donation of Silk
quests.summary: As with most other fabrics, our stocks of silk are at an all-time low.  Our stores are such that we'd only need sixty pieces of silk from you total; we should be able to reach our goal with the support of others.A benevolent gift such as silk, might I add, would certainly increase your local standing in the community!  If you have the sixty pieces of silk cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.

quests.name: A Donation of Wool
quests.summary: We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.  A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by the Undercity for your generous actions.  Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.

quests.name: Additional Runecloth
quests.summary: Greetings once again, <name>!  Our need for runecloth is constant, and we can always use additional resources if you are willing to part with them.  For an additional stack of twenty runecloth, I will make sure that you are recognized for your continuing efforts on behalf of the Undercity.Whenever you are ready to hand in the stack of runecloth, I'll accept it.
